description: Header file defining the RDKBLoggerAgent class, which provides an interface for logging and debugging functionalities in the RDK platform. It includes method declarations for initializing, logging, retrieving environment variables, and setting log levels, among others.

classes.name: RDKBLoggerAgent
classes.description: A class inheriting from RDKTestStubInterface and AbstractServer, providing methods for logging, environment management, and debugging in the RDK platform.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the logger agent with a specified version.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations for the logger agent.

methods.name: testmodulepre_requisites
methods.description: Pre-requisite setup for the test module.

methods.name: testmodulepost_requisites
methods.description: Post-requisite cleanup for the test module.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Init
methods.description: Initializes the logger agent.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log
methods.description: Logs a message with specified module and level.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Dbg_Enabled_Status
methods.description: Checks if debugging is enabled for a module.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_EnvGet
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables for a module.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_EnvGetNum
methods.description: Gets the number of environment variables.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_EnvGetValueFromNum
methods.description: Gets environment variable value by number.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_EnvGetModFromNum
methods.description: Gets environment module name by number.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_CheckMPELogEnabled
methods.description: Checks if MPE logging is enabled.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log_All
methods.description: Enables logging for all modules.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log_None
methods.description: Disables logging for all modules.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log_Trace
methods.description: Enables trace logging for a module.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log_InverseTrace
methods.description: Enables inverse trace logging for a module.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log_Msg
methods.description: Logs a message with specified module, level, and message.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_SetLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_GetLogLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level.

methods.name: RDKBLoggerAgent_Log_MPEOSDisabled
methods.description: Logs that MPEOS is disabled.
